notes.title: The Animated Update.
notes.notes:
After the Early Access release, this is our first update, and we're bringing you 4 out of 8 things for the final release.


✔️ Workshop to share and download levels.
✔️ Slime movement improvement.
✔️ Cloud save.
✔️ Create the version for Mac and Linux.


But, is that all this update has? Of course not.
You'll definitely notice the major change in this update. Our beloved slimes are now much prettier and more slimy.

Another important feature of this update is the debug information menu. To fix any bug faster, we have added a debug menu, very easy to activate, just press "F3" on the keyboard to display it, and press "F3" again to hide it, if you find a bug, send us a screenshot with the debug information enabled.

The last important feature that has been added, is a data storage for analysis, but don't worry, we are not collecting personal data, or applying labels to know who the data belongs to. The data collected is from the levels, such as how long it takes you to finish a level, or where the hardest parts are, this is to identify if a level is too difficult, and reorder, or even redo the level.

Chages in this update:

Replaced slimes animations.
Added levels leaderboards.
Added Steam Workshop.
Added Steam Cloud.
Debug info (Press F3).
Analytics.
Added some sounds.
Added more menu options.
Bug fixes.
